title: Demographics of South Korea
displaytitle: Demographics of South Korea

titles.display: Demographics of South Korea

extract: Demographic features of South Korea's population include population density, ethnicity, education level, health, economic status, religious affiliations, and other aspects of the population. The common language and especially culture are widely considered more important elements by South Koreans in terms of identity than citizenship.
